about_the_game:
The SAI team welcomes you

Join the workforce of the Immediate Assistance Service —a.k.a. SAI—, a job where providing first aid to people who need it is the number one mission of every employee. Your first days at work, however, will prove it's not as easy and rewarding as it sounds.

A cyberpunk world inspired by Latin American culture

Get to know the bright colors, neon lights and high rise buildings of the dystopic metropolis Illari. The beautiful and disorienting facade of the city hides, as you'll soon realize, the sad reality of economic inequality and precarious living conditions caused by the hyper-technologization and political corruption.

Your days off will open for you the chaotic downtown of Illari; you'll meet its picturesque inhabitants, make friends (or foes) and buy traditional food, products and collectibles at the unique stores adorning the neighborhood.

Choose your own adventure

Inhabit Dani's skin through the game's dialogue-focused, non-linear story where anyone you interact with and every decision you make impacts Dani's world view and future.

Watch the consequences of your actions change the course of the game through one of the multiple endings you'll get at the end of your first month as an illarian and SAI employee.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains themes that may not be appropriate for all ages or may result sensitive for some people, such as: mild violence, mild language, alcohol and drug use, general mature content.
